diagnosis.confirmed_defect: The profile resolver ranks priority_bucket before action category, so a valid declared interrupt in bucket 1 does not preempt an ordinary bucket-0 threat action while the selected target is actively casting.
diagnosis.observed_contributor: At the fifth opportunity Pummel was also observed as temporarily invalid for insufficient rage, increasing the need to select it immediately when it becomes valid during the controlled cast.
diagnosis.telemetry_limit: The closed batch retains 30-second status snapshots rather than every individual resolver decision, so the exact competing spell at the missed decision was not serialized.
diagnosis.narrow_correction: When the selected target is actively casting, prefer the best otherwise-valid declared interrupt candidate over all ordinary candidates; retain real spell readiness, resource, range, and execution checks and do not synthesize success.
